risk_note: Contract task (contracts/openapi.yaml, enums/admin.yaml, error-codes.yaml, contracts-ts conformance and the regenerated contracts-ts and route tables): adds GET /admin/v1/risk-rules (adminListRiskRules) and POST /admin/v1/risk-rules/{rule_id}/enable and /disable (adminEnableRiskRule / adminDisableRiskRule), all x-implementation planned, per 04 §6.6 / §3.2 / §11.2, BR-ID-36 and rulings D10-152 / 155 / 157 / 159 / 164. Follow-ups outside this task: risk_rules lacks name / threshold_keys columns, and migration 0014 separates version from row_version (the implementation decides the mapping). tester none; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent (one run; test machine verify-fast/1 green).
